description: A dim, purple-lit room with a glossy purple touring motorcycle parked in front of an upright piano, a ruffled purple garment draped over the piano, and a stool in the foreground. Behind them a large window shows rain streaks and blurred city lights, and amplifiers and mic stands sit at left under stage lights with purple haze filling the air. A tiny mark sits in the bottom-right corner, and the painting fills the whole frame with no border.
